AudioSection.description: The sound part of a block.

latency_samples.description: The delay the block adds, in samples (recorded; not yet compensated).

module.description: The WebAssembly module in the package (for example `block.wasm`).

tail_ms.description:
How long the block keeps sounding after its input stops, in
milliseconds (recorded; clips are not yet extended by it).

warmup_ms.description:
How much sound to run through the block after a jump before its
output is used, in milliseconds (at most 4000). 0 for blocks without
memory.

BlockKind.description:
What a block is: the media it works on and its role. Decides where its
nodes may live and which stages it may declare.

oneOf.description:
Changes a clip's picture (in clip, track and sequence effect lists of
picture tracks).
How one picture clip turns into the next at a cut.
How a layer combines with the picture beneath it.
Makes a picture from nothing (a clip's source).
Changes sound (in clip, track and sequence effect lists of sound tracks).
Crossfades sound at a cut.
Makes sound from nothing (a clip's source).

anyOf.description: The same limit for every component.

Bound.description:
A lower or upper limit: one number for every component, or one number
per component (`[0, 0, -1]` for a vec3; `[x, y]` for a curve's points).

DefaultFor.description: Which default the block is for the editor.

oneOf.description: The block "fit to frame" adds when a stack has no scale role.

The transition the editor's "add a cross dissolve" gesture puts on an
edge of a clip on a track of this block's kind (a `video.transition`
for picture tracks, an `audio.transition` for sound tracks). Only
transitions may say this.

value.description:
What is stored in the project: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`,
at most 64 bytes. Never change it without a migration.

FixedFunction.description: A blend the GPU's fixed-function blending does, so no code is needed.

oneOf.description: Premultiplied "over": the normal blend.

Fold.description: How several nodes of the same block in one stack combine.

oneOf.description: Every node runs, in stack order (the default for plug-ins).
Only the last enabled node of this block in the stack runs.

All enabled nodes fold into one run at the position of the first;
each parameter folds with its own rule.

anyOf.description:
Text per language, keyed by a language tag such as "en", "fr" or
"pt-BR". "en" is required.

LocalizedText.description:
Text for people: either a plain string, which is English, or an object
from language tag to text (`{"en": "Glow", "fr": "Lueur"}`), which must
include English. The editor shows English for now.

Migration.description: How to bring nodes written for parameter format `from` to format `to`.

from.description: The parameter format the steps start from.

to.description: The parameter format the steps arrive at.

MigrationStep.description: One step of a parameter migration.

oneOf.description: Give a parameter a new id (its value and keyframes move with it).

Multiply a number (float, int, every component of vec2, vec3 and
color), keyframes included.

Add to a number (float, int, every component of vec2, vec3 and
color), keyframes included.
Replace enum values, keyframes included; values not in the map stay.
Give old nodes that do not have the parameter this value.

value.description: The value, in the JSON shape of the parameter's type.

oneOf.description: Drop a parameter from old nodes.

advanced.description: Hidden in the inspector's simple mode.

components.description:
Labels for the components of a vec2, vec3 or color (default X, Y /
X, Y, Z / R, G, B, A).

default.description:
The value a node without this parameter has, in the JSON shape of
the project's parameter values (`12.0`, `[0.5, 0.5]`,
`{"r": 1, "g": 1, "b": 1, "a": 1}`, `"gaussian"`).

description.description: What the parameter does, for people and for the AI.

fold.description:
How the parameter folds; required for every parameter when the
block's fold is `params`, refused otherwise.

hidden.description: Never shown; kept on the node (used for inert legacy parameters).

id.description:
`[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`, at most 32 bytes, unique in the block, not a WGSL
keyword. It is stored in projects: never rename it without a
migration.

keyframable.description:
Whether the value can be animated with keyframes. Left out: yes for
float, vec2, vec3, color, shape and curve, no otherwise. Transition
parameters are never animated.

max.description:
Highest allowed value: a number for every component, or one per
component.

min.description:
Lowest allowed value: a number for every component, or one per
component.

options.description:
The choices of an `enum` parameter (required for enums, refused
otherwise).

role.description: What the parameter means to the editor.

step.description: The inspector's step for this number.

unit.description: The unit the number is shown in.

ParamFold.description: How one parameter folds when the block's fold is `params`.

oneOf.description: Values are added, starting from the default.
Values are multiplied, starting from the default.
The last node's value is used.

ParamType.description: The type of a parameter's value.

oneOf.description: A number (f64 in the project, f32 for the code).
A whole number (i64 in the project, i32 for shaders).
True or false (0 or 1 for the code).
One of the declared `options` (its index for the code).
Two numbers.
Three numbers.
A colour {r, g, b, a}.
A rectangle, ellipse or path in layer coordinates.
Points of a curve.
Text.
A key of data kept in the project (stored as a `dense_curve` value).
A key of large data kept in the machine's cache.

PassDecl.description: One pass stage: a draw of its own for neighbourhood effects.

input.description: The one picture the pass reads: `layer`, or an earlier pass's output.

inputs.description: The pictures the pass reads (at most 4), instead of `input`.

name.description: The WGSL function `fn <name>(uv, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`.

output.description:
The intermediate picture the pass writes. The one named `result`, or
else the last pass's output, is what is composited.

scale.description:
The intermediate's size as a share of the output size, 0.25 to 1
(default 1). Set by the first pass that writes the intermediate.

Role.description:
What a parameter means to the editor, so features of the editor can use
it without knowing the block. A closed list in manifest
version 1.

oneOf.description:
Layer opacity (a float): every opacity value of every enabled node of
the stack is multiplied into the layer's opacity.
Placement: scale (a vec2).
Placement: position (a vec2).
Placement: rotation (a float).
Placement: anchor (a vec2).
Sound level in decibels (a float).
Stereo position (a float).

Stage.description: A picture stage a block provides as a WGSL function.

oneOf.description: `fn region(r, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`: the visible part of the layer (crop).
`fn place(pos, luv, ctx, p) -> vec2<f32>`: where a corner goes.
`fn pixel(c, uv, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`: colour, alpha, masks.
`fn source(uv, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`: a generated picture.
`fn blend(src, dst, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`: a layer over what is beneath.
`fn transition(a, b, uv, ctx, p) -> vec4<f32>`: two clips into one.

TransitionSection.description:
A transition's style and, for fades, its opacity curves.
Each curve is a list of `[progress, opacity]` points, both 0..1,
progress strictly rising from 0 to 1, evaluated piecewise-linearly.

incoming.description: Opacity of the incoming clip when there is an outgoing one.

incoming_alone.description: Opacity of the incoming clip when nothing precedes it (a fade in).

outgoing.description: Opacity of the outgoing clip when there is an incoming one.

outgoing_alone.description: Opacity of the outgoing clip when nothing follows it (a fade out).

style.description: `fade` (picture only, no code) or `mix` (code combines both clips).

oneOf.description: No code: the editor draws both clips with opacities from the curves.
The block's code combines both clips.

Unit.description:
The unit a number is shown in. It is for people: the stored value is
what the block reads. `fraction` is a share of something, 0..1 (shown as
a percentage); `percent` is stored as 0..100.

oneOf.description: Sequence pixels.
Degrees of angle.
Percent, stored as 0..100.
A share, stored as 0..1.
Decibels.
Milliseconds.
Seconds.
Hertz.
Photographic stops (powers of two).
A factor: 1 leaves things as they are.
A plain number without a unit.

VideoSection.description: The picture part of a block.

fixed_function.description:
A blend done by the GPU's blending hardware (only the editor's own
normal blend may say this).

passes.description: Pass stages, run in order (filters only; at most 4).

source.description:
The WGSL file in the package (for example `block.wgsl`); required
when the block declares stages or passes.

description: block.json: what a ChadFX effect block is, what parameters it has and what code it provides.

$schema.description:
Where an author's text editor finds this schema (for example
"../block-manifest.schema.json"). Ignored by the editor.

default_for.description:
The editor's default block for something (only the editor's own
blocks).

description.description: What the block does, for people and for the AI.

fold.description:
How several nodes of this block in one stack combine (default
`none`; blends are always `last`).

format.description:
The version of the parameter format (1 or more). Nodes store it;
raise it, with a migration, whenever parameters change meaning.

homepage.description:
A web page about the block (shown only, never opened by the editor
on its own).

id.description:
The block's id, `namespace.name` (`acme.glow`), at most 64 bytes.
`chadfx.` is reserved for the editor's own blocks, `core.` for core
nodes.

migrations.description: How to convert parameters of older formats, oldest first.

params.description: The parameters, in the order the inspector shows them.

version.description: The block's version for people, a semantic version (`1.2.0`).
